title: Cloudy with a chance of files
subtitle: The roof is not a data center.
takeaway: Cloud storage keeps files on remote computers, accessed online.

boards.heading: Access has conditions
boards.note: Online access needs a working connection.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: I put my laptop on the roof. Better cloud reception.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Bring it down. You are uploading rain.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Wait. The cloud is not actually in the sky?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Your files live on remote computers. The internet connects you to them.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: So my photos have moved out and got their own apartment?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: An extremely noisy apartment full of servers.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Can I reach them without the internet?

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Online files need a connection. Download copies ahead of time if you need them offline.

turns.speaker: student
turns.text: Fine. I am still buying my laptop an umbrella.
